skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Apply basic concepts related to data mining and knowledge discovery from data, functions and applications.
Apply statistical analysis methods, data visualization techniques, similarity measures for data objects.
Apply data preprocessing techniques such as cleaning, integration, reduction, transformation.
Use pattern mining, association rules, and data relationships. Apply advanced pattern discovery problems.
Use classification algorithms in knowledge discovery and data mining. Use advanced classification methods.
Use basic clustering algorithms in knowledge discovery from data. Use advanced clustering data methods.
Understand basic knowledge about data warehouses and online data analysis.
Apply knowledge discovery processes in economic and business problems.
Demonstrate ability to learn independently, seek information or form study groups.
Work collaboratively on problem-solving activities assigned by instructors.
